summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Direxion Daily S&P 500 Bear 3X ETF (SPXS) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the S&P 500 index. The fund provides 3x inverse exposure to a market-cap-weighted index of 500 large- and mid-cap US companies selected by the S&P Committee. SPXS was launched on Nov 5, 2008 and is issued by Direxion.

holdings.infoBox: SPXS is an equity ETF with a total of 11 individual holdings.
